1. Line breaking is natural
2. No orphan characters (孤字)
3. No text pressing against lines/borders (压线)

Actually the text ends at 「断了。」 around x~945, and the column/divider line ends around x~1050. So no overflow.
2. No orphan characters: yes — no lone 「断了。」 line; entire text is one line.
3. No pressing against lines (压线): the text sits between the divider above (below 02 手套 heading) and the divider below. It doesn't touch any line. Let me check spacing: the divider above is at ~y570, text at ~y660, divider below at ~y745. Clear gap, no collision.

Everything else on the slide looks fine: 01 反光 two lines wraps naturally ("不是分辨率。" second line has 5 chars + period — that's acceptable, not a single orphan character; it's a natural wrap, and this wasn't part of the review scope anyway). 03 没网 one line. Right column text fine. Page number 02 / 14 present.

Verdict: pass.
